reviews.author: J. Gay
reviews.text: Corríher Electric recently installed a new 200-amp electrical service in my building. They also installed new light fixtures and multiple outlets throughout the building. From start to finish, Randy was professional, knowledgeable, and dependable. He explained the work clearly, completed the project on schedule, and made sure everything was installed safely and up to code. The quality of the workmanship was outstanding, and the installation was clean and well organized. Randy paid attention to detail, kept me informed throughout the project, and left the work area spotless when they were finished. It's clear he takes pride in delivering high-quality work. I highly recommend Corríher Electric to anyone looking for a reliable and experienced electrical contractor. I will definitely use them again for future electrical projects

reviews.author: Jeannie Beaver
reviews.text: Just want to give a shout out to Mr Randy Corriher for the outstanding, professional work that he did at our home. I would highly recommend him for any electrical work. He's very reasonably priced. He very neat with his work and cleans up throughout the job. He replaced lighting, added a dedicated circuit, added outside outlets, changed 2-space interior outlets to 4-space and installed some ceiling fans. Will definitely keep him in my reservoir of house maintenance contacts.

reviews.author: James Bullock
reviews.text: Randy is an A+ electrician with years of experience and knowledge, attention to detail, and impeccable work ethic. We had extensive work done getting our mother’s home up to code and we could not have chosen a better guy for the job! He went over and beyond to thoroughly research and being solutions to a few problematic issues along the way. We live out of town, and trusted Randy completely with a key to her home. He is honest and fair, and a man of strong character.

reviews.author: P Douglas Small
reviews.text: Randy was great. Efficient. Reasonable. Neat. He was respectful in our home. Professional. When he ran into some issues. Unanticipated, he persevered. We would highly recommend him.

reviews.author: Sara Compton
reviews.text: I had a great experience working with Randy to update the outlets and switches in my whole house. He was reliable, easy to communicate with, efficient, knowledgeable, and pleasant to chat with over the two and a half day project. He explained confusing electrical things in a way that made sense. His pricing was very reasonable. If you need electrical work done, I absolutely recommend Randy!

reviews.author: James Johnson
reviews.text: Randy did a great job for us. He communicated well, gave great suggestions and was an easy person to work with. Very professional.

reviews.author: Larry Brooks
reviews.text: Randy did an amazing job! He upgraded my electrical box, added a whole home surge protector, and generator outlet (that I hope I will never need to use, and ran a new electrical line to our sunroom for a heater. Everything was done professionally and clean. Great communication too.

reviews.author: Jenn
reviews.text: Randy is amazing, professional, polite, punctual, and trustworthy. I have had to step out while Randy was working in the house and I had no reservations about doing so. Randy has also saved me money on what I thought needed to be replacement hardware by repairing it and suggesting that I return expensive items purchased. All around great person to work with!

reviews.author: Chance Williams
reviews.text: Had 2 EV chargers installed , Corriher took the time to discuss the options with me about location for them. He also helped me with the rebates from Duke Energy. He was always on time and did an excellent job. Would hire him again for any electric need

reviews.author: Gary
reviews.text: Randy was amazing! He finished the job in less than half the time of the next bid we got, and his work is high quality. We had a large overhaul of our entire house’s electrical system, and he made sure to verify everything we wanted/needed before starting. He explained it all when we had questions, displaying a great deal of patience & charm few people have anymore. Would definitely call him again for our electrical needs.

reviews.author: Ed Moore
reviews.text: I highly recommend Corriher Electric. I reached out to Randy as a result of a recommendation from another service provider and I was very impressed. Randy responded quickly and scheduled an appointment to assess the job. He explained everything very clearly and provided a very fair quote. Within a week, the work was performed. Very professional, knowledgeable and just a great person to work with. We plan to use Randy for some other upcoming projects as well.

reviews.author: Jennifer Black
reviews.text: Randy was the best decision I made for my new homes elecrical work. He was professional, did his work with care, kept in contact with me the entire time and his pricing was excellent for my budget. He got my house up to code and hung all my new light fixtures in a small time frame. I will recommend Randy to anyone looking for a fantastic electican.

reviews.author: Virginia Maguire
reviews.text: Randy resolved an ongoing problem with the light for my flag. I’m sure it will stay working now for many years to come. He was efficient,professional, a delight to work with.

reviews.author: John Harrington
reviews.text: First visit to my home. Enjoyed having Randy. He was very helpful with several issues through out my home. will call him again soon! Rhonda

reviews.author: Ricky Godwin
reviews.text: We had a great experience with Randy! I called him about midday to see if he could come out and fix a receptacle issue we had and he was very accommodating in working us in to his busy schedule the same day. Very professional and very nice Explained everything that he did and took the time to listen to us about a couple of other issues that we had. Would highly recommend his services!! AAA+++

reviews.author: Ms. Harriet OldSchoolDiva
reviews.text: Randy has been a great service to our community for many years. He has completed several projects at my home and I am very happy! He is very professional yet personable. He also is not greedy and will give you a fair price. Thanks Randy!

reviews.author: Ryan Saubier
reviews.text: Randy is great, he put in a 200 amp service panel and an additional 50 amp sub panel for my house/ hot tub. His work was very clean and professional.

reviews.author: Julie Jordan
reviews.text: Dealing with Randy was a real pleasure. We were getting a 70’s home ready for the market and discovered the basement was a DIY project, not up to code. Because it was a mess an estimate was hard to do. We gave Randy the go ahead not sure what it would cost. In the end not only did he do a great job he was reasonably priced. Our trust in Randy’s honesty proved to be a great decision. I would highly recommend Randy & Corriher Electric.

reviews.author: Gene Correll
reviews.text: Randy was able to help me on a spur of moment, without an appointment. Working on my neighbors house, he came and helped me with my problem.

reviews.author: carolyn cooksey
reviews.text: Great experience using Corriher Electric Co. Randy did an amazing job installing a whole house surge protector and connection for a generator. He was excellent in communicating throughout the project! We will definitely use Randy again for any future electrical needs! Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Charles King
reviews.text: This was the 2nd time that we needed an electrician quickly. He was able to come in a very timely manner, his work was great and the price was fair. Whenever I need electrical work done, Randy is my guy!!

reviews.author: Donald Callahan
reviews.text: Randy did an outstanding job for us from beginning to end. In preparation for setup of a new portable power generator, Randy provided us with different options and great advice for updating our electric panel. He did a fantastic job on the new setup, and installed an interlock kit and a generator breaker, along with an external hookup to the generator. All of this work was completed in a very timely manner and with the utmost professionalism, at a competitive rate. Randy is top notch, and we couldn’t be happier with the outcome.

reviews.author: andrew shook
reviews.text: Randy did a great job with our home electrical upgrade, and has been responsive from the start. He was able to fit our project in ahead of our move in to our new house, which was greatly appreciated so as to not disrupt our electrical service. Randy was timely and worked quickly and handled all of the inspections/paperwork required to get the job done.

reviews.author: dawn martin
reviews.text: Randy is fantastic. My power went out and wasn't sure why. He truly took time to explain. And then my roommate came home and he was very thorough explaining to him!The whole experience was perfect. I will definitely recommend him to friends!

reviews.author: Lemuel Carde
reviews.text: Randy did a great job for us from start to finish. We were looking for someone to install a new portable power generator, and Randy provided us with different options. He did a terrific job and installed an interlock kit and a generator breaker. All of this work was done in a very timely manner. We are extremely satisfied and would definitely recommend Randy to anyone needing electrical work done!

reviews.author: Lori Clark
reviews.text: They did everything I wanted the way it works for my needs. Very neat job. The service was very good. Thanks for a awesome job.

reviews.author: Mher Saribekyan
reviews.text: Randy was caring and professional from the moment I contacted him. I called in regards to having a portable generator set up for my home and he even recommended which generator I should get so I can use the natural gas in my home. He also recommended a plumber to do the gas job which worked out great. Randy was responsive, on time and efficient and even walked me through his work. Being a small business, and run by Randy his pricing was the best I got and so was the plumbers. I’d definitely recommend Randy and call him again for my electricity needs.

reviews.author: Freddy Coon
reviews.text: Corriher Electronic Co. Done a excellent job today at my house I would recommend Randy to anyone to do electric work

reviews.author: Michele Pitts
reviews.text: Randy saved the day for our family! Our new stove was being delivered and we needed a new outlet installed in time for Thanksgiving. When I explained the situation to Randy, he made arrangements to fit us into his busy schedule to make sure everything was in place to install the new stove. Randy is very professional and knowledgeable about his customers' needs. We definitely will use Randy again!

reviews.author: Douglas Meyer
reviews.text: Randy is an amazing electrician. We had a bad experience with a previous electrician and even though Randy was 8 weeks out, he put us at the top of his list to make our house safe again. Randy arrives early and puts in a full day. He listened to our needs and discussed every possible solution. A great experience and our electrician for life!!!! Doug and Jana Meyer

reviews.author: Sam List
reviews.text: I’ve known Randy for a very long time. I’ve used him for multiple electrical projects and he is always diligent and professional in his manner and work ethic. He does the job as if it was his own house. I will always continue to use him for my electrical needs. Thanks Randy!!

reviews.author: Alois Bolton
reviews.text: Randy did a huge project for my farm this summer and did an incredible job. He repaired issues with existing lighting in my shop set it up for hvac power for a project later on. He listened to my ideas and gave advice on doing it cost effectively. He set up power for my welders and air compressor. In my stable he lit it up like a hospital as we planned. He added motion sensing security lights outside. He helped plan out how to safely set up our chicken processing area to have power and lights for future needs. Randy is an exceptional electrician and I highly recommend him for any of your electrical needs.

reviews.author: James Simonds
reviews.text: Mr. Corriher installed an ev charger for me. He showed up on time and worked professionally. He made sure he understood what I was looking for before he started. After installation, he even helped me assemble the needed documents for a Duke Power Rebate. He will be the only one I call when I need electrical work done.

reviews.author: Angela Patrum
reviews.text: I chose Randy based upon prior reviews and they were accurate!! He was quick to respond and was kind enough to work us into his busy schedule; the issue was diagnosed and repaired quickly. He was very polite and professional. I highly recommend him!!

reviews.author: Kari Lukas
reviews.text: After having two other “electricians” at our house who couldn’t figure out why my stove wasn’t working, Randy was recommended by a friend. As soon as I explained to him what was happening, he knew immediately what to look for. He needed to replace the outlet, didn’t have one in his truck so he ran to the store & less than 24 hrs after I called him I had my stove back! If you want a reliable, honest, knowledgeable, friendly electrician I HIGHLY recommend you call Corriher . His phone number is staying in my contact list!

reviews.author: Neal Hopper
reviews.text: Randy did a wide variety of things for us and was especially good at thinking down the road to possibilities that we might encounter as well as alternative ways of addressing our immediate needs. He listened to our needs and responded to those using his long experience as an electrician. His rates seemed comparable and he was always my first contractor to show up each day. We will use him again on some upcoming projects. Oh yeah, he is a really nice guy too.

reviews.author: Rebecca Barlow
reviews.text: We highly recommend Corriher Electric and are so thankful we found them to do some work for us! We had a bad experience with a contractor who damaged some of our outside electrical. Randy came out and patiently walked around and through our entire house looking at all the damage and the list of additional work we needed done. He was great about explaining everything and making sure we had input on every decision needing to be made. He communicated well with us, was on time always, was very thorough and careful with his work, and went above and beyond in all that he did. It was honestly a pleasure to have him here and we look forward to working with him again as we continue to fix our home.

reviews.author: Christy H
reviews.text: Randy is an excellent electrician. He is very knowledgeable and very reputable. I could not be a happier customer and will recommend him to my family and friends. Highly recommend his company for all of your electrical needs.

reviews.author: Todd Anderson
reviews.text: I can’t say enough about Randy and his work. Needed to run a dedicated circuit to an above ground pool and he did an amazing job. He was on time and always followed up when he said he would. In the process of getting an inspection for the electrical we found out that the initial pool installation (done by someone else) failed to be grounded and bonded. He researched what needed to be done for that and worked with me to get that secondary project completed and passed inspection as well. Now we are 100 percent confident that we have everything right for a safe swimming environment for our family. Thanks again Randy!

reviews.author: Richard Payne
reviews.text: Randy did an excellent job for me at my home. I needed a partial electrical system replacement due to damage from a storm. He made numerous measuements and took photos to quote the job. My insurance company said that was helpful in reaching an amount for the damage. I will hire him again for an upcoming project at my home.

reviews.author: Diann Steele
reviews.text: I have used their service several times and the work has always been good. They are always professional and are there when promised. Randy is truly a nice guy. Will always use him when I have electrical work. I highly recommend him. Diann Self (married name)

reviews.author: Rob Billings
reviews.text: Examples of Randy’s work are outstanding. He is meticulous and professional. He ran power to my hot tub and did several other jobs for me and my son. Awesome results!!! Highly recommend him for any electrical work you need.

reviews.author: Starr Black
reviews.text: Randy has done numerous jobs for both myself and my clients. He is always responsive, professional, shows up when he says, and does an excellent job. Everyone I've referred him to has been happy with his work.

reviews.author: Erica Reliford
reviews.text: Mr. Randy Corriher of Corriher Electric was prompt, educational, and most importantly transparent when helping us narrow down the issue of renegade electricity consumption that was causing an obscene energy bill. His attention to detail helped identify issues with our HVAC and well. He even extended his support to the HVAC technician explaining what he both saw and heard helping to quickly identify the issue. Lastly, Mr. Corriher provided affordable recommendations and patiently explained why he would use the products. His pricing for services rendered was fair and more importantly his customer service is top tier!!! Please add this company to your list of vendors for any electric service needs!

reviews.author: Ian Cantrell
reviews.text: Randy is not only one of the nicest people I've ever met but he's an extremely knowledgeable and fast worker. His assistance with my home project helped me accomplish everything safely and effectively. I will rely on Corriher Electric for all future electrical needs.

reviews.author: Shane Little
reviews.text: Randy was great at working with us to run electrical to a new rear porch area and installed ceiling fans for us as well. He took care of the permit and scheduling for the county inspector as well. Highly recommended for good work at a fair price!!

reviews.author: Randy Hartness
reviews.text: Randy Corriher done more than a excellent job.It was superior in every way , he was on time.He done exactly what we wanted and even some things that he suggested that was even better than what we wanted and charged exactly what he said he would No surprises. Can't get better than him and his excellent work.

reviews.author: Brenda Trott
reviews.text: Randy was on time for the repair and was very professional and fixed two lighting fixtures that had broken ballasts. He was able to schedule the visit within one week from when we needed help. We highly recommend him if you need an electrical repair.

reviews.author: Sandra Nannie
reviews.text: Randy did a great job hooking up my new generator and everything works perfect. I always get him to do my electrical work. Honest, trustworthy, reliable and friendly.

reviews.author: brenda benton
reviews.text: Randy was here when he said he would be. He texted me estimates on some various projects and was here on time to do the scheduled work. I have already contacted him to do some more work for me! He is so nice; does great work and dependable.

reviews.author: Laura Hart
reviews.text: Randy couldn’t have been easier to work with! Excellent service and work well done. We will definitely use him for any electrical work in the future.

reviews.author: Alesa Ruddy
reviews.text: Randy with Corriher Electric was awesome. Very knowledgeable in trouble shooting my electric problem and fixing it. Great communication from the time I called him to the finish. Will use him again and highly recommend him to friends.

reviews.author: Robin Hatley
reviews.text: We called about a concern with some electrical outlets in our home. Mr. Corriher was kind enough to come look at our issue the next morning. Thankfully he got the receptacle replaced, it had the wrong wiring and caused overheating. He also checked other receptacles and our electric box to make sure all was secure. Thank you so much Randy for your expert service and being honest with us about what all needed to be done. We highly recommend your service and will call you anytime we need an electrician.

reviews.author: Andrew Prickett
reviews.text: Excellent service! He completely redid my panel in just one day while minimizing time without power for my wife and kids! Very professional and quality work. He was able to handle multiple different querks about our project and answer all of my questions with no issue or hesitation. We will definitely be using him again for future projects!

reviews.author: Mike Goodman
reviews.text: Randy installed an extra switch to turn a light on from either entrance. He also ran wiring from my breaker panel to the attic for future lights and switches. Very professional, polite and helpful. Highly recommend!!!

reviews.author: Cathy Pope
reviews.text: Randy did a great job installing, moving and fixing electrical plugs. His suggestions were helpful in getting me to decide what I really wanted. Will use him again when needed.

reviews.author: Darcy Armstrong
reviews.text: Corriher Electric was very professional and knowledgeable. He was able to repair and install an electrical wire and switch so we could have use of our well and Cookstove. The work was very well done and showed he had much knowledge of electrical work. I would recommend him for any electrical services.

reviews.author: Dog Training Elite Charlotte
reviews.text: Corriher Electric Co took on our project of lighting outside and a new outlet inside. We called a few companies as we were looking into getting estimates and were surprised so many were charging a fee for an estimate and operator answering phone had little to no knowledge and couldn't get help until having someone out to look at the space. We kept looking for someone knowledgeable to answer the phone and we landed on Corriher Electric and so happy we did. He was quick to respond, answered all questions, got us on the schedule and now have awesome lighting outside and a working outlet inside. Thank you Corriher Electric for your help to get us exactly what we needed.

reviews.author: Yogesh Patel (Yogi)
reviews.text: Randy was very personable and we were very satisfied with the work. We had new wiring,outlets and switched installed to our deck. Also some indoor repairs.

reviews.author: gary hoyt
reviews.text: Randy was awesome, he went above and beyond rewiring most of my house. He was up front about what my options were and easy to work with when changes had to be made.

reviews.author: Woody Chavis
reviews.text: I requested an estimate for the job from several sources. Mr. Corriher responded quickly and gave me an estimate. Most of the other providers acted as if they didn't want the job or said it would be months before they could even provide me with an estimate. Mr. Corriher had a quote in my hand within 3 days. We set a mutually agreed upon date for the work to be completed. He was on time, professional, and provided me with all the details involved in the work. I was certainly impressed with Mr. Corriher's work ethic. He was meticulous and went that extra mile to make sure that the work area was clean. Digging a trench was involved and he took all precautions to minimize any damage to my yard. I was very impressed with Corriher Electric and would recommend their work to all my family and friends. I would certainly use Mr. Corriher and his company again! Woody Chavis

reviews.author: Stacey Durst
reviews.text: Friendly, professional and very responsive! Will definitely be using Corriher Electric again for any of our future jobs!

reviews.author: Henry King
reviews.text: Randy was great to work with. He showed up when he said he would, was very professional and his price was more than fair.

reviews.author: JJ Johnson
reviews.text: Installed an electrical outlet on our back patio. Randy was a pleasure to work with and quality of work was excellent.

reviews.author: Rich Rubino
reviews.text: Randy is very knowledgeable and knows his craft I was very happy with the installations that he did for me and the repairs that he did for me I would recommend Randy Corriher.

reviews.author: James Cline
reviews.text: Randy Corriher was a pleasure to do business with....He provided status reports on my project regularly, and did a professional job that was done in a timely fashion....I will use Corriher Electric on all my future projects........Highly Recommend

reviews.author: Jeff Andrews
reviews.text: Randy installed LED lights in my attic. He also hung a tv in my office. His work is superb and punctual.

reviews.author: Lee Bo
reviews.text: What a great service from corriher Electric Co. The services we excellent. He went above and beyond what we thought he would do. We are thankful for greatful to do business With this company. Thank you

reviews.author: George Jones
reviews.text: We were just getting a quote on a project, but impressed with Randy's skill, honesty, and personality. Clearly a "go to" guy for all your electrical projects.

reviews.author: Christy
reviews.text: Look no further, Randy provides excellent service. He's a great communicator and detail oriented. We highly recommend him!

reviews.author: Coralee Reith
reviews.text: Prompt, competent, and reasonably priced service. Would definitely call Randy in the future for any electrical work needed.

reviews.author: Carrie
reviews.text: The most thorough, conscientious electrician we’ve dealt with. Fixed an issue others had not been able to address.

reviews.author: Jon Womack
reviews.text: Excellent, licensed electrician. Cannot say how much I trust him to handle anything I throw at him. He always does a professional job. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: John Huffstetler
reviews.text: Randy is an excellent electrician and take time to do the job right. He cares about his neighborhood and customers

reviews.author: Pat White
reviews.text: Randy wired my shed. He has some great ideas that will prove to be beneficial in the futures. Excellent work!

reviews.author: Melissa Quick
reviews.text: Randy is wonderful to work with and very responsive. I would definitely recommend Corriher Electric.

reviews.author: Cindy Fine
reviews.text: Wonderful man and a great business to work with! You know from the first minute that this is a person that you want to do business with! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Janice Sisk
reviews.text: Out of all the electricians that have been here for a problem we've had for a while. He located the problem and fixed it. No more problems.

reviews.author: Prayerful Human
reviews.text: These people gave me an estimate, and it ended up being too pricey for me. I went with someone else.

reviews.author: Mark Lee
reviews.text: If you're looking for an electrician, especially for renovations, this is the guy you should talk to!!!
